task_resources: original CPU, memory and storage settings; independent task copies omit the agent deadline
termination: agent completion, explicit cancellation or API failure

agentsight.semantic_capture: native SSL uprobes attached to the Pi Node executable
agentsight.analysis: upstream correlation script and independent semantic analyzer

sentinel.integration: Pi lifecycle and tool events using original A2M protocol
sentinel.system_capture: native eBPF and BPF-LSM tracer and enforcer
sentinel.analysis: original context summarizer, auditor, rules and caches

installation.audited_conditions: independent copies of the byte-identified official installation
installation.validation: archive SHA-256, Node SHA-256, Pi CLI SHA-256 and version

transport: common TLS gateway with role-specific usage accounting

nodrop_kernel_isolation.certificate: initial per-trial module load and unload
nodrop_kernel_isolation.logs_and_git: one case per kernel boot; module retained until restart
